work.author: Pope John Paul II
work.description: The apostolic letter of 16 October 2002 by which John Paul II presented the Rosary as Christocentric contemplation, proposed the five mysteries of light as an addition left to the freedom of individuals and communities, and proclaimed the Year of the Rosary (October 2002 - October 2003). The text is numbered in 43 sections, the locus system used here.
